summary: The customer called technical support because they were struggling to set up a newly received Wi-Fi extender. The agent guided the customer patiently through the initial steps, including plugging it into an outlet near the router and understanding the blinking red indicator light. The call ended while the customer and agent were waiting for the device to finish powering up so they could proceed with connecting via smartphone.

evidence.text: Thank you for calling SwiftConnect Technical Support, my name is Marcus. How can I help you today?
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent was polite, introduced themselves and the company clearly, and maintained a courteous and helpful tone throughout the call.

evidence.text: No worries at all. Let's take it one step very slowly.
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent acknowledged the customer's confusion with reassuring statements and adjusted the pacing to accommodate the customer's needs.

evidence.text: Once you select that network on your phone, a setup page should automatically pop up on your screen.
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent provided clear troubleshooting steps that were actively moving toward a resolution, though the call ended abruptly while waiting.

evidence.text: For the initial setup, please plug it into an outlet that is in the same room as your main router.
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent gave clear, concise instructions and checked for understanding, avoiding confusing technical jargon.

evidence.text: Once you select that network on your phone, a setup page should automatically pop up on your screen.
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The transcript cuts off mid-process, meaning proper closing protocols (summarizing, asking if anything else is needed, professional sign-off) could not be completed.

evidence.text: A blinking red light just means it is powering up and waiting for a connection.
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The information provided regarding device indicators and setup procedures was accurate and appropriate for a Wi-Fi extender.

evidence.text: First, can you plug the extender directly into a standard wall outlet near your main router?
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent followed a logical troubleshooting workflow appropriate for initial hardware setup and onboarding.

quote.text: Hi, yes, I just got this new Wi-Fi extender in the mail and I am completely lost on how to plug it in and make it work.
